_help: TMG Holding consolidated statements, EGP millions. net_income = profit attributable to shareholders of the parent; income_continuing_ops = consolidated net profit (incl. non-controlling interests). ebit = operating income less the depreciation line shown below it; ebitda = ebit + total depreciation and amortization from the cash-flow statement. sga = G&A + marketing. receivables = trade and notes receivables only (notes for undelivered units are offset by an equal liability). securities = FVTPL + time deposits and amortized-cost assets (current and non-current). total_debt = loans (current + non-current) + credit facilities + sale-and-leaseback notes payable to lease companies at nominal value (notes 24/26 H1 2026, notes 25/27 FY2025); long_term_debt = non-current loans + non-current lease notes. Ordinary leases excluded. interest_expense = finance cost in profit or loss + borrowing cost capitalized into properties under development (note 14). total_equity includes non-controlling interests; minority_interest is shown separately. shares_outstanding in millions.

periods.source: TMG Holding consolidated FS for the year ended 31 Dec 2024, statement of profit or loss p.6, 2023 comparative (https://talaatmoustafa.com/upload/TMG%20Conso%20%20FS%2031%20December%202024-English.pdf). Before the 2024 hotel acquisitions.

TMG Holding audited consolidated FS for the year ended 31 Dec 2025, 2024 restated comparatives (pp.4-6, cash flow p.8; restatement in note 45: EPS 4.68 -> 4.38 after the Legacy hotels fair-value adjustment). total_assets_begin = 31 Dec 2023 total assets from the FY2024 FS p.3 (https://talaatmoustafa.com/Upload/Consolidated%20financial%20statements%20for%20the%20year%20ended%2031-12-2025-English.pdf)
